verdict.rationale: Weave documents a public Service API with REST endpoints for programmatic access, alongside documented Python/TypeScript SDK entry points and a documented OTLP ingestion endpoint, so an AI-native user can drive the product programmatically. The OpenAPI probe returning 404 at the guessed docs.wandb.ai paths does not contradict the documented REST API; it only means no machine-readable spec was found there. missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe paths 404), detail on the REST API's endpoint coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Weave via the API

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use the Weave Service API, which provides REST endpoints for programmatic access to Weave functionality.
When you decorate a function with `@weave.op()` (Python) or wrap it with `weave.op()` (TypeScript), Weave automatically captures its code, inputs, outputs, and execution metadata.
This endpoint lets you send OTLP (OpenTelemetry Protocol) formatted trace data directly to your Weave project.
Custom agents — wrap your own loop with `start_conversation`, `start_turn`, `start_llm`, and `start_tool`.
